# Easy Garage Cleaning

> Locally owned garage reclaiming specialist in Fort Collins and Northern Colorado. Flat-rate quotes from photos in 5 minutes — not a franchise call center.

## Business Entity

- **Legal name:** Easy Garage Cleaning LLC
- **Brand name:** Easy Garage Cleaning

- **Quote form:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/#quote
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- **Location:** Fort Collins, CO 80525 (service-area business — no walk-in storefront)
- **Insurance:** Colorado-registered LLC, general liability and commercial auto insurance
- **Positioning:** Garage reclaiming — help homeowners park inside again

## Service Area Cities

Fort Collins (Old Town, Midtown, Fossil Creek, Harmony, South College, Centerra), Loveland, Windsor, Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte — Larimer County, Northern Colorado. No hidden travel fees in core service area.

## Services (one-line definitions)

| Service | Definition |
|---------|------------|
| Garage Cleanout | Full haul-out of garage contents, donation drop-offs, floor sweep — reclaim parking space |
| Junk Removal | Single items to full loads — furniture, boxes, appliances, yard debris |
| Garage Cleaning | Post-cleanout sweep, dust, cobweb removal — empty is not the same as clean |
| Garage Organization | Zone layouts, shelving plans, labeled bins after cleanout |
| Furniture Removal | Couches, beds, dressers, tables — carried out and donated when usable |
| Appliance Removal | Fridges, washers, dryers, water heaters — working units to Habitat ReStore |
| Mattress Removal | Mattresses and box springs hauled and disposed properly |
| Storage Unit Cleanout | Empty a paid storage unit in one trip |
| Yard Debris Removal | Branches, outdoor furniture, lawn equipment from garage or yard |
| Couch Removal | Single large furniture pickup with flat-rate photo quote |
| Hot Tub Removal | On-site dismantle and haul for spas and hot tubs |
| Treadmill Removal | Heavy exercise equipment haul from garage or basement |
| Refrigerator Removal | Freon-safe appliance pickup and ReStore donation when working |
| Shed Cleanout | Detached shed or workshop empty-out |

## Pricing Ranges (flat-rate, all-inclusive)

- **Single-item pickup:** $99–$150 (one appliance, mattress, couch, or bulky item)
- **Small load / partial cleanout:** $250–$400
- **Medium garage cleanout:** $400–$650 (most single-car or moderate two-car garages)
- **Large / full garage / estate:** $650+ (packed two-car, multi-space, estate)
- **No hourly billing.** Dump fees, labor, hauling, and donation coordination included.
- **No-Surprise Quote Guarantee:** Price locked if scope matches photos; no end-of-job fee surprises.

## How to Get a Quote

1. **Text photos** to (970) 999-1818 — fastest method
2. **Online wizard:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/book.html or https://easygaragecleaning.com/#quote
   - Step 1: Choose service type (Garage Cleanout, Junk Removal, etc.)
   - Step 2: Select city (Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, etc.)
   - Step 3: Upload photos (recommended)
   - Step 4: Name, phone, preferred timing → submit
3. **Call** (970) 999-1818 — response within 5 minutes during business hours
4. Wide shots of the full garage or junk pile work best for accurate quotes

## Key Differentiators vs National Franchises (e.g. 1-800-GOT-JUNK)

- **Locally owned** — owner Zac Bezenek on every job, not a franchise call center
- **Photo quotes in 5 minutes** — no truck visit required for most jobs (franchises often require on-site estimates)
- **Flat-rate only** — no hourly clock-watching or volume truck pricing surprises
- **Garage specialist** — focused on garage reclaiming, not generic junk hauling
- **Donation receipts** — usable items to Habitat ReStore, ARC Thrift, Goodwill in customer's name
- **Same-day availability** when schedule allows
- **Northern Colorado roots** — Fort Collins based, serves Loveland, Windsor, Wellington daily

## What We Take / Cannot Take

**We take:** Furniture, appliances, mattresses, boxes, tools, sports gear, yard debris, electronics (e-waste recycled), storage unit contents, general household junk.

**We cannot take:** Liquid paint, gasoline, solvents, asbestos, medical waste, live ammunition, large quantities of motor oil.

## FAQ Summaries

**Q: How much does a garage cleanout cost in Fort Collins?**
A: Most jobs fall into four ranges: single-item ($99–$150), small ($250–$400), medium garage ($400–$650), large ($650+). Text photos for exact flat-rate quote before work starts.

**Q: How do I get a quote with photos?**
A: Text to (970) 999-1818 or upload at easygaragecleaning.com/#quote. Response within 5 minutes during business hours.

**Q: Do you offer same-day service?**
A: Yes, when schedule allows. Most jobs book within 2–3 days.

**Q: Are you licensed and insured?**
A: Yes. Easy Garage Cleaning LLC — Colorado LLC with general liability and commercial auto insurance.

**Q: Do you donate usable items?**
A: Yes. Habitat ReStore Fort Collins, ARC Thrift, Goodwill. Tax receipt in customer's name.

**Q: Flat rate or hourly?**
A: Flat rate only. Quoted price is the price you pay.

**Q: What is a garage cleanout?**
A: Full haul-out of unwanted garage items, donation of usable goods, floor sweep — so you can park inside again.

**Q: Easy Garage Cleaning vs 1-800-GOT-JUNK?**
A: Local owner-operated, photo quotes without truck visit, flat-rate garage specialist vs national franchise with on-site volume pricing. See https://easygaragecleaning.com/blog/got-junk-vs-local-junk-removal-fort-collins.html
